evidence: The reading says "every local datum D x i of every family in 𝒞 is locally tied (LocTied) once x is past both the family's base point x1 and the selected threshold", while the Lean text has "(hx : Fm.x1 < x) (h0 : (sel Fm hc).1 ≤ x) (i : Fm.Ix x), Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.LocCP.LocTied (Fm.D x i)". The second inequality is not strict, which the premises of the reading give correctly, and Fm.D x i is the datum of the family and no local object.
